descriptions.text: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

Make yourself at home in one of the 293 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries.

activities.activityName: Dubai Sky Views Observatory Ticket with Free Glass Slide + Photos
activities.description: Discover the Dubai Sky Views Observatory with its thrilling Glass Slide, a must-visit attraction offering a unique and exhilarating experience in the heart of Dubai. Located atop the Address Sky View Hotel, this tour combines the Observatory, Sky Slide, and Sky Edge Walk for an unforgettable adventure. With your standard Sky View Dubai ticket, you gain access to the Observatory, boasting mesmerizing views of Dubai, and the Sky Slide, a thrilling descent through a transparent glass tube from the 53rd to the 52nd level. Take in panoramic views of iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and Sheikh Zayed Road as you capture stunning photos on the 25-meter-long glass walkway connecting the twin hotel towers. Don't miss the chance to ride the first-of-its-kind Glass Slide for an adrenaline rush like no other. Book your Dubai Sky Views tour today and prepare to be captivated by the city's breathtaking vistas and unmatched thrills.

inclusions.otherDescription: Get the most compelling views over Dubai’s skyline and beyond as you zoom up 219.5 meters high

The Dubai Sky Views tour is an absolute must-visit. Sky Views from Emaar, which is perched atop the Address Sky View Hotel, combines three thrilling activities—the Observatory, Sky Slide, and Sky Edge Walk—into one. The Observatory, which offers the most mesmerizing views of Dubai, is included in your standard Sky View Dubai ticket, as is access to the Sky Slide, which whisks you down from the 53rd level to the 52nd level through a completely transparent glass tube while ensuring the most fantastical views of the surroundings.
Take Pictures:

A 25-meter-long glass walkway connecting the towers of this twin hotel, which is located at a height of 219.5 meters, is the main attraction of the Observatory's two levels. Skip the hassle of shared group tours; and travel stress-free in comfort of a private, air-conditioned vehicle with convenient pickup and drop-off included, accompanied by a knowledgeable guide who uncovers the true spirit of the city with his insightful commentary.

Discover the crown jewels of the capital including Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Etihad Towers, Abu Dhabi Corniche, Emirates Palace, Qasr Al Watan Royal Palace, Heritage Village, Dates Souk, Ferrari World and everything in between making it a comprehensive tour. activities.description:
We will explore the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque as seen through the eyes of a native Emirati Tour Guide. Also discover how the third-ranked attraction on the 'World’s Most Amazing Landmarks' list by TripAdvisor was originally just the personal dream of Sheikh Zayed, which came to life.
Other things to note
In Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque there is a underground plaza, where the meeting point is, has food court and coffee shops for refreshments (own expense).
There is free drinking water fountains.

NOTE**:
Face Masks are Mandatory and Can be provided.
Transportation can be provided from the hotel and back on extra cost.

itineraryItems.description:
We will get to know how the personal dream of our Founding Father, Sheikh Zayed, came to life and how it is now the third most popular tourist attraction in the world!
Walking under multiple domes and passing through each column, we will discover the fascinating architectural details of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. We will also discover the Islamic beliefs and ideas behind the building.
